    By aurracloud.com
    CLI to install and setup MCP servers


Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -v, --verbose                  Enable verbose output
  -d, --debug                    Enable debug output
  -q, --quiet                    Suppress all output except errors
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  install [options] <package>    Install and setup an MCP server
  uninstall [options] <package>  Uninstall an MCP server
  list [options]                 List all installed MCP servers for a client
  list-cloud [options]           List all available cloud SSE tools from
                                 aurracloud.com
  info [options] <package>       Get comprehensive information about a package
                                 from integrated registries
  upgrade                        Upgrade mcp-cli to the latest version
  login [options]                Authenticate with the MCP registry to enable
                                 cloud installation
  logout [options]               Remove authentication credentials for the MCP
                                 registry
  publish [options]              Publish an MCP server to the registry
  help [command]                 display help for command
